notes: PDF has 10 pages; printed page numbers 2–10 start after the title page (title page counted as page 1). Capability Results on page 5 say results are listed below, but pdftotext extracted no benchmark numbers (likely an image/table); card points to deepmind.com/models/evals-methodology/gemini-3-pro — those external numbers were not extracted. Safety scores are absolute percentage-point deltas vs Gemini 2.5 Pro, not absolute rates; several rows are annotated non-egregious. Text-to-text safety is a -10.4% regression (red in the card). FSF cyber alone met the alert threshold while all CCLs were not reached. Red teaming is internal specialist teams, not named external testers. More FSF detail is in the separate Gemini 3 Pro Frontier Safety Framework Report. Seed maps Gemini 3 Pro to google/gemini-3-pro-preview. Last Updated May 2026 noted on the card.
